result:
All three deliverables are in place and verified:

- **`script.R`** — self-contained, runs clean via `Rscript script.R`, Okabe-Ito palette + theme declared up top, `set.seed(1)` before anything stochastic, estimates all-attribute AMCEs with `projoint()` (profile-level, IRR-corrected, respondent-clustered SEs via `.auto_cluster`).
- **`figures/amce-dotwhisker.png`** — dot-and-whisker plot, faceted/colored by attribute, levels ordered within attribute, baselines at zero with no whisker, 2560×2880 px @ 320 dpi, no in-plot title. I visually inspected it and it renders correctly.
- **`report.md`** — 192-word results paragraph (largest effects: violent crime -25.1pp, driving time -23.7pp, housing cost -19.8pp, type-of-place +11 to +16pp, school quality +11.6pp; notes vote share/racial composition were not significant; one sentence on clustered SEs), with the figure and caption placed underneath as specified.

Used 1 of 3 allowed delegations (fast-worker built the script/figure to spec); I independently reran the script to confirm the numbers matched exactly before writing `report.md` myself, and no revision cycle was needed.
